requirement.description: The next_token function has several issues with token recognition and parsing. It fails to correctly identify and return token types for integers, real numbers, names, and comments. Additionally, it doesn't properly handle incomplete tokens and has incorrect logic flow for nested structures like dictionaries and arrays.
requirement.contract: The next_token function must correctly identify and return token types for all PDF syntax elements including INTEGER, REAL, NAME, COMMENT, STRING, DICT, ARRAY, STREAM, TRUE, FALSE, KEYWORD, and handle incomplete tokens by returning None for the token type. The function should properly handle nested structures and return accurate start/end positions for each token.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function has issues with parsing dictionaries, arrays, and references. It fails to properly handle PDF reference objects (like 6 0 R) and nested structures. The function also has problems with parsing simple objects like booleans and basic values.
requirement.contract: The parse_obj function must correctly parse all PDF object types including dictionaries (<< >>), arrays ([ ]), references (6 0 R), booleans (true/false), integers, real numbers, names (/name), and strings. It should properly convert references to complex numbers (e.g., 6 0 R becomes 6j) and handle nested structures correctly.

requirement.description: The build_chrono_from_xref function has IndexError issues when processing cross-reference tables and streams. It assumes certain data structures exist and doesn't handle edge cases gracefully, causing failures in simplefile tests.
requirement.contract: The build_chrono_from_xref function must handle all possible cross-reference table formats and gracefully handle missing or malformed data without throwing IndexError exceptions. It should properly parse both traditional xref tables and xref streams.

requirement.description: The replace_ref function has flawed logic for identifying and converting reference tokens. It doesn't correctly handle the tokenization process to detect references and has improper indexing logic.
requirement.contract: The replace_ref function must correctly identify reference tokens (number 0 R) and convert them to complex numbers (e.g., 6 0 R becomes 6j). It should properly handle the tokenization context and not skip valid tokens.

requirement.description: The parse_xref_table function has incorrect logic for processing xref table entries and extracting object information, leading to IndexError in simplefile tests.
requirement.contract: The parse_xref_table function must correctly parse xref table entries and extract object information including object number, generation number, and absolute position. It should handle both standard and extended xref table formats properly.
